article_title: From scooters to shampoo - the people saving hundreds from dumpster diving

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?
options: To argue that every city should ban recycling
To show why several people dumpster dive, what they find, and the legal questions involved
To compare the prices charged by British supermarkets
To explain how to start a professional waste company
tasks.correct_answer: To show why several people dumpster dive, what they find, and the legal questions involved
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה כמה צוללי־פחים, את המניעים והחפצים שהם מוצאים, וגם את המורכבות המשפטית.

tasks.prompt: What did Darryl Baker do before taking items from the supermarket's dumpsters?
options: She paid the supermarket for every item.
She reported the items to the police.
She asked supermarket staff for permission.
She waited until the supermarket closed permanently.
tasks.correct_answer: She asked supermarket staff for permission.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: דריל ביקשה רשות מצוות הסופרמרקט לפני שלקחה את הפריטים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “salvaged” most nearly mean?
options: Thrown away deliberately
Bought at full price
Hidden from the owner
Recovered from being wasted or destroyed
tasks.correct_answer: Recovered from being wasted or destroyed
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המילה salvaged מתארת פריטים שניצלו מאובדן או מהשלכה לפח.

tasks.prompt: How does Jeff Ferrell make money from some of his finds?
options: He sells discarded metal to a scrapyard and his wife sells other valuable finds online.
He charges people to enter private dumpsters.
He receives a salary from Fort Worth for collecting soap.
He rents his bicycle to other dumpster divers.
tasks.correct_answer: He sells discarded metal to a scrapyard and his wife sells other valuable finds online.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ג'ף מוכר מתכת למגרש גרוטאות, ואשתו מוכרת באינטרנט פריטים אחרים כמו עתיקות ותכשיטים.

tasks.prompt: Why is summer a particularly good time for Charlotte Bayford to search bins near Essex University?
options: Local shops replace all their toiletries in summer.
Students leave and discard things they do not want to take home.
The university holds a yearly charity auction.
Only summer bins are legally open to the public.
tasks.correct_answer: Students leave and discard things they do not want to take home.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כשסטודנטים חוזרים הביתה בקיץ, הם משליכים חפצים ומוצרי רחצה שאינם רוצים לקחת עמם.

tasks.prompt: What does Millie Diamond mean when she calls herself “a bit of a magpie”?
options: She is afraid of climbing into bins.
She collects only black-and-white clothing.
She is attracted to and collects interesting objects.
She can identify every bird near her home.
tasks.correct_answer: She is attracted to and collects interesting objects.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההשוואה לעקעק מתארת אדם שנמשך לחפצים מעניינים ואוסף אותם.

tasks.prompt: Compare how Darryl Baker and Millie Diamond use the clothing they find.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר שימוש אחד או יותר של כל אישה ולהראות הבדל ברור ביניהן.
expected_points: Darryl keeps clothes for herself and relatives, donates some, and sells some items.
Millie specifically searches for fabrics and clothing to salvage and refashion into new items.
Millie sells some of the redesigned pieces.

tasks.prompt: Why might dumpster diving be both financially useful and risky?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר יתרון כספי וסיכון משפטי או מעשי על סמך הכתבה.
expected_points: Divers can save hundreds by reusing clothes, toiletries, food and household goods.
Some sell metal, antiques, jewellery or clothing for income.
Rules differ by place; discarded property may belong to a city, waste company, owner or business.
Entering private property can create a risk of trespass charges, so asking permission is safest.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the experiences of the four dumpster divers and the legal caution in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את דריל, ג'ף, מילי ושרלוט ואת ההסתייגות המשפטית, בלי להוסיף מידע שאינו בכתבה.
expected_points: Darryl saved hundreds through clothing and household finds after asking permission.
Jeff has dived for more than 50 years, gives away many finds and sells metal and valuables.
Millie refashions discarded textiles, while Charlotte times searches around student move-out and reuses toiletries and sealed food.
The legality depends on location and circumstances, and taking items may involve ownership or trespass issues.

tasks.prompt: Write a short safety-and-ethics notice for someone considering dumpster diving, using the article's legal advice.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה מעשית שמדגישה רשות, רכוש פרטי ובטיחות מזון, על בסיס הכתבה.
expected_points: Ask the owner or business for permission when in doubt.
Do not assume that an item is free merely because it is in a bin or skip.
Avoid trespassing and check local rules.
If mentioning food, limit it to sealed items and use cautious language.
